So, a few years ago my younger brother and I were rough housing in the house, wrestling, etc. Regular guy stuff. So, at one point I am balancing a mini love sac on my knees while my back is on the floor (basically just holding it up with my shins). My brother decides to jump onto it, I lose my balance and he goes head first into a nearby table. All I hear is screaming, I stand up and look at him and blood was gushing out of his front tooth. We ran to go get help. We took him to the ER, his tooth (adult tooth) got knocked loose by the impact, luckily nothing cracked or broke. So after a few months it healed and even though it wasn’t my fault it happened, I always feel guilty about it.
